courses.requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must meet the eligibility criteria, which include membership of a student project group before the end of week 1, where the project has been approved by the convener.
To enrol in this course you must:
be enrolled in the Master of Computing (MCOMP) AND 
have successfully completed:
(COMP6442 or COMP2100) AND
(COMP6250 or COMP8260 or COMP8280) AND
have successfully completed or be currently enrolled in (COMP2120 or COMP6120)
OR
be enrolled in the Master of Machine Learning and Computer Vision (MMLCV) AND 
have successfully completed:
(COMP6442 or COMP2100) AND
(COMP6250 or COMP8260 or COMP8280)
Incompatible with COMP8755 and COMP8830 and COMP8800.

courses.title: Advanced Computing Research Project
courses.requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must:
be enrolled in the Master of Computing (Advanced) OR Master of Machine Learning and Computer Vision AND
have completed or be currently enrolled in COMP6445 AND
have completed (COMP8280 or COMP8260 or COMP6250) AND
have completed 36 units of COMP courses AND
have a GPA of 6 out of 7 AND
receive a permission code by completing the steps listed on Enrolling in student projects and having submitted the Student Project Registration Form.
Incompatible with COMP8715 and COMP8830.
